frases: Your brand new fence post is already leaning!
Hit like and follow. Flo set this one in ten minutes!
I dug a hole one foot deep. That's plenty for a post!
Too shallow. The wind pushes the fence like a sail, and the post tips.
And where it freezes, the frozen ground swells. It lifts the post a little more every winter.
So how deep is deep enough?
A common rule: bury about one third of the post.
An eight foot post? Almost three feet in the ground.
And in cold climates, go below your local frost line.
And what do I pack around it?
Gravel or soil, a few inches at a time. Tamp every layer hard.
Fine. A deeper hole. My arms hate you.
One foot deep, or one third of the post? Team Norm or Team Flo?
